stories.title: Floating bus stop report finds they pose 'low risk'
stories.summary: TfL releases new safety reports about the stops but campaigners say the findings are wrong.

stories.title: Plane tail appears to strike runway during Heathrow landing
stories.summary: Flight BA431, travelling from Amsterdam, was approaching the runway when the pilots aborted the landing and carried out a go-around.

stories.title: Where do London's air pollution alerts come from?
stories.summary: Londoners received a high air pollution alert this week, which comes from Imperial's expert anaylsis.

stories.title: Youth scheme branded 'failure' as 42% find work or study
stories.summary: Under half of those on the youth schemes took up work, education or training in London, new data suggests.

stories.title: Aphasia group write song about their experiences
stories.summary: Tens of thousands of Londoners live with aphasia, which impacts speech, reading and writing.

stories.title: Demolition for century-old weightlifting club site
stories.summary: The club can stay until June 2027 and will not have to move until a new suitable venue is found.

stories.title: Barge tradition revived in Lord Mayor's show
stories.summary: A centuries-old river journey returns, while artists put the final touches to a Tower Bridge float.

stories.title: Skye Newman gets 'goosebumps' over record-breaking Brixton Academy run
stories.summary: She is the first British female solo singer to play a five-gig residency at the venue.

stories.title: Brand will face 'hell on earth' in Wandsworth prison, says former inmate
stories.summary: The disgraced entertainer was sentenced to 10 years and six months for rape and sexual assault.

stories.title: 'We all need data, but do we need the largest data centre in Europe here?'
stories.summary: Green belt land in North Ockenden is the proposed site for a huge data centre campus, one of the largest in Europe.

stories.title: Call for employment support for people with sight loss
stories.summary: Lord Holmes says the barriers to employment include policy, funding and employer practices.

stories.title: Families of Croydon tram crash victims say justice not been done
stories.summary: Seven people died when a tram came off the tracks on a sharp bend in Croydon on 9 November 2016.
